premise.text: Seed terms: Monsters, Security Guard, Marina, Affection being stymied, Wise, Suspicious
premise.headline: Romance gets stopped at the velvet rope.

jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Visitor Pass
jokes.joke: My girlfriend said I never show affection, so I surprised her at work with a big romantic hug in the lobby. The security guard stepped between us and said, “Sir, do you have a badge or an appointment?” That hurt. I finally tried emotional availability and still needed a visitor pass.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Cleared
jokes.joke: I finally worked up the nerve to ask out the woman I'd been making eyes at for three months. Leaned in, said, 'I'd really love to take you to dinner sometime.' She smiled — actually smiled — and then the security guard at the museum stepped between us. Turns out you're not allowed to talk to the paintings.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Night Shift
jokes.joke: Being a dad is basically working as an unarmed, unpaid security guard. My son woke me up at 3 AM, terrified there was a monster under his bed. I grabbed my phone flashlight, cleared the perimeter, and checked under the mattress. No monsters. I did, however, find a half-eaten grilled cheese sandwich from October. Honestly, I’d prefer a monster. Because whatever was growing on that bread had already invented the wheel.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Security Date Killer
jokes.joke: I took my date to this quiet overlook last weekend, trying to get a little affection going. You know, the moment's right, I'm leaning in... and bam, this security guard hits us with the flashlight. 'You can't be here after dark!' Affection being stymied by a guy whose whole job is ruining vibes. I told him, 'Relax, we're not stealing the view, we're just borrowing it for two minutes!' He radioed backup anyway. Now my love life has a permanent 'no trespassing' sign.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Guarded Feelings
jokes.joke: I tried flirting with a security guard the other day, but it went nowhere. Every time I smiled, he just held up a hand like, “Ma’am, I’m gonna need you to step back.” I wasn’t even hitting on him that hard—my heart just kept setting off his emotional metal detector.

Clean execution, natural rhythm, and the 'visitor pass' button lands well. The setup is familiar but the final line reframes it crisply. Slightly predictable territory but delivered without waste.
The grilled cheese pivot is genuinely unexpected and earns the escalation. 'Invented the wheel' is a strong closer — absurd but grounded in a real domestic image. Best surprise turn in the batch.

'Emotional metal detector' is a genuinely fresh image and carries the joke efficiently. Concise and clean. Slightly low on escalation — one more beat could have elevated it — but the restraint also keeps it tight.
